guard: The chat stream's history limit: a new space starts with no age limit and 1000 per sender, `cotal up` leaves every existing stream's limit as it is and still refuses a chat stream that is not canonical apart from its limit, the provisioner may update the chat stream and no other message stream, a broker refusal of the update is not reported as an unknown outcome, recall reads the stream's own limits and its head, and durable catch-up copies what the stream holds without judging retention.
why: The suite imports core from `src`, so no build is needed and each mutant is what the suite runs. Every cell
runs against a live broker, so a mutation is graded by the broker's own permission checks, expiry and stored
config. Each mutation reddens a different named cell.

mutations.name: the provisioner loses its chat stream update grant
mutations.expectRed: the provisioner may set the chat stream's limit
mutations.cell: the provisioner may set the chat stream's limit
mutations.note: Without the grant `cotal history limit` is refused on every authed space.

mutations.name: the grant is widened to the DM stream
mutations.expectRed: the provisioner may not update DM_
mutations.cell: the provisioner may not update DM_<space>

mutations.name: the default goes back to 30 days
mutations.expectRed: a new space's chat stream starts with no age limit and 1000 per sender
mutations.cell: a new space's chat stream starts with no age limit and 1000 per sender

mutations.name: cotal up moves a stream on the old settings to 30 days, as 0.134.0 did
mutations.replace:
await readChatStreamConfig(jsm, opts.space);
    { const { config } = await jsm.streams.info(chatStream(opts.space)); if (config.max_age === 0 && config.max_msgs_per_subject === 1000) await setChatHistoryLimit(jsm, opts.space, { maxAgeMs: 30 * 86_400_000, perSender: 1000 }); }
mutations.expectRed: cotal up leaves a chat stream with no age and 1000 per sender (every stream's limit before 0.134.0) as it is
mutations.cell: cotal up leaves a chat stream with no age and 1000 per sender (every stream's limit before 0.134.0) as it is
mutations.note: The move deleted every post older than 30 days at an ordinary upgrade (#5643).

mutations.name: setup stops checking an existing chat stream
mutations.expectRed: a chat stream with any setting other than its limit off canonical is refused
mutations.cell: a chat stream with any setting other than its limit off canonical is refused
mutations.note: `createSpaceStreams` skips an existing chat stream, so this read is the only check of one at `cotal up`.

mutations.name: a permission refusal of the update is reported as an unknown outcome
mutations.find: if (e instanceof JetStreamApiError || isPublishPermissionDenied(e)) throw e;
mutations.expectRed: a credential without the update grant is refused, not reported as an unknown outcome
mutations.cell: a credential without the update grant is refused, not reported as an unknown outcome

mutations.name: catch-up judges the per-sender count again
mutations.find: await this.catchupCopy(owner, lifecycleUid, channel, joinCursor, fence, generation);
mutations.replace:
await this.catchupCopy(owner, lifecycleUid, channel, joinCursor, fence, generation);
    { const info = await this.jsm!.streams.info(chatStream(this.space), { subjects_filter: chatSubject(this.space, "*", "*", channel) }); if (Object.values(info.state.subjects ?? {}).some((n) => n >= info.config.max_msgs_per_subject)) { await tombstoneMember(kv, channel, owner, lifecycleUid, fence, this.card.id, generation); return { durable: false, reason: "activation catch-up window partially evicted by retention", generation }; } }
mutations.expectRed: a join whose channel is exactly at the per-sender count, behind another channel's post, activates with both posts
mutations.cell: a join whose channel is exactly at the per-sender count, behind another channel's post, activates with both posts
mutations.note: Stream state cannot tell this channel's eviction from another channel's removal, so a sender at the count proves nothing; the mutant tombstones a join that lost nothing.

mutations.name: recall ignores the stream head
mutations.expectRed: recall reports a channel whose posts are all gone, with the stream head past the watermark
mutations.cell: recall reports a channel whose posts are all gone, with the stream head past the watermark

mutations.name: recall judges the count against the compiled 1000, not the stream's limit
mutations.expectRed: recall reports a channel where a sender passed the stream's per-sender count
mutations.cell: recall reports a channel where a sender passed the stream's per-sender count
